teal.$description: Signal Teal — active, focus, and linked state. Narrow role: never a primary or default action color.

relay.$description: Deprecated compatibility alias for Signal Teal. Use color.palette.teal; remove this alias in v2.

gold.$description: Mission Gold — priority and editorial hierarchy

orange.$description: Ignition Orange — primary action and editorial signal. The dominant brand hue; ration it to one job per surface, not a flood.

signal.$description: Signal Green — nominal and success state

rust.$description: Alert Rust — warning and degraded state

fault.$description: Fault Red — error, critical, and destructive state
